transcript.content: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. [Name]. Well, I'm here because... I guess what finally made me ask for help is that I just keep forgetting these little things I normally handle without any problem. It's getting frustrating. Like, I'll forget to return a phone call, or I won't turn in a registration form on time, or I'll completely forget to stop and run an errand on my way home from work. It's just... happening a lot lately.
When did you first notice this forgetfulness starting? Was it sudden, or has it been gradually getting worse over time?

Well, I wouldn't say it was completely sudden, but it definitely started getting noticeably worse about 15 months ago. That's when I started an evening certificate program. Ever since then, trying to keep my attention on things and just... stay organized has been a lot harder to manage.
Over the past 15 months, have you noticed any changes in your mood — such as feeling more sad, anxious, or down than usual?

No, not really. I haven't noticed anything like that. I mean, I definitely get frustrated with myself when I mess up or forget something I was supposed to do, but... no, I haven't been feeling sad or anxious or down. My mood has been pretty normal, honestly.

Besides the forgetfulness with everyday tasks, have you noticed any changes in your ability to remember important events from your past, or have you had any trouble with things like doing math, finding the right words, or recognizing people you know?

No, nothing like that. I can remember things from my past just fine, and I haven't had any trouble with math or knowing who people are. It's really just those everyday things, like errands and forms, that I keep dropping the ball on.

When you're trying to focus on something important, do you find it hard to concentrate, or is it more that you're just overwhelmed with everything you're trying to juggle between work and your evening program?

I think it's more that I actually find it hard to concentrate. It's not just feeling overwhelmed by everything. Like, if I'm at the office or in class... the smallest thing will distract me. Just one phone ringing, or people talking nearby, or even a random thought popping into my head about something at home... it just pulls me right off whatever I was working on.

Going back to when you were a child and in school — did you have similar problems with concentration and getting distracted back then, or is this something that's really only started happening since you began the evening program 15 months ago?

No, it's definitely not new. I mean, even back in elementary school, I was the kid who always forgot to bring home permission slips. I'd lose my homework somewhere in my backpack, even if I actually did it. My mom or my teachers always had to remind me, like, step by step, just to get me to finish any kind of project. So, yeah, it's pretty much always been like this.
When you were in elementary school, did you have the same trouble with concentration and getting distracted by small things like you're describing now, or did that problem develop later on?

Yeah, it was the same with the concentration, too. I'd just... drift off. Like, I'd be looking around the classroom or daydreaming instead of doing my worksheets. So, um, getting distracted easily by little things, that was definitely there back then as well. It didn't just develop later on.
